title.zh: USDC被列为欧盟首个「重要电子货币代币」
title.en: USDC被列为欧盟首个「重要电子货币代币」

current_state.zh: The European Banking Authority designated Circle-issued USDC as the EU's first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, transferring direct supervision of its capital, reserves, liquidity and recovery/redemption plans to the EBA from France's ACPR starting 12 November 2026, and paired with a new EBA–NYDFS cooperation memorandum.
current_state.en: The European Banking Authority designated Circle-issued USDC as the EU's first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, transferring direct supervision of its capital, reserves, liquidity and recovery/redemption plans to the EBA from France's ACPR starting 12 November 2026, and paired with a new EBA–NYDFS cooperation memorandum.
